notes.title: Update 1.51
notes.content:
The following fixes have been made in this release:


 Fixed collision bug where the player could fall if they were close to a corner when throwing a grenade.
 Grenade explosion radius increased.
 Added life item in stage 8-1.
 The light effect of the streetlight in area 9 has been improved.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
This update brings a new item to the game to balance the difficulty, now the stages have life recovery items, and you can pick them up when you have less health than when you started the stage.

This item is available in easy and normal modes and will help on your journey to finishing the game.

In hard mode this item is not available because you only have 1 life available.

notes.title: Bug fix in stage 3-2
notes.content: Fixed a bug in stage 3-2 where you could fall at the beginning of the stage and not be able to get back.

notes.title: Update 1.41
notes.content:
In this update is now possible to play the survival mode with two players, with separate leaderboards.

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Get ready, co-op is available in Ninshi Masuta's new update, now it's possible to play the main mode with 2 players offline!

When played in this mode, all achievements remain active, only steam rankings are disabled.

Team up with a friend and save the city from the gang terrorizing the city!

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
This update brings new features for Ninshi Masuta:


 Survival Mode - In this mode you are in the room full of ninjas, try to survive for the most time possible (Steam leaderboards supported)

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
New update on the game Ninshi Masuta:

- New achievement created.
- Fix on collision of the laser.

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update bring some new features to the game:


 Challenge all bosses in a row with just one life, can you win this mode? (available after beat the game)
 New option to start the game without using a save, if you don't want to delete one of the 3 that you have.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
This update fixes a bug that sometimes the grenade don't work correctly.

Support for a new achievement: "Big explosion".

notes.title: Hotfix 1.03
notes.content: This update fixes a bug that caused the game to crash when someone uses the spacebar to jump.
